content: A log-bilinear CRF module is used for the NER task, and takes three inputs. The first is the sequential character-positional embeddings mentioned above. The second is the hidden vector from LSTM as dynamic feature inputs. The third is lexical features extracted from the input text. These lexical features are the likelihood of a character being at a specific position of a noun (first character of a noun, second character of a noun, etc.), and is achieved by comparing the character with a pre-defined dictionary trained by BIBREF13.
